A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, at large-N, the partition function of the four-dimensional N=4 supersymmetry gauge theories with symmetries Sp(N) or O(N) is equal to the partition function of a ten-dimensional N=2 supersymmetric gauge theory, dimensionally reduced to the zero dimensions of the instanton moduli space.

the instanton measure in the large-N limit is a partition function of a supersymmetric gauge theory in zero dimensions, and the saddle-point solutions are dual to AdS/CFT geometries in the large-N expansion.
the AdS /CFT correspondence is not a duality of quantum field theories but a duality of classical field theories.
